The first-author/adviser and official university talk provide direct group linkage rather than coauthorship alone.

unknowns: RIGVid uses pretrained video generation, VLM filtering, pose tracking and retargeting, not a newly trained end-to-end VLA policy. Its default tracker requires an object mesh obtained from a prior RGB-D object scan, and real initial depth is required. No task demonstrations does not mean no physical sensing or preparation.

Evaluation starts from fixed task configurations and assesses defined final-state criteria. Pouring success checks spout placement above the plant, not measured water delivery. The four-task result should not be described as unrestricted general manipulation.
The July 2025 preprint and May 2026 revision dates are kept distinct. CRAFT is additional March 2026 physical-hand research, not necessary evidence of learned autonomous behavior here.
